mapper.update: INSERT INTO resume_profiles (user_id, name, target_role, summary, education, internship, projects, skills) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{targetRole}, #{summary}, #{education}, #{internship}, #{projects}, #{skills}) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, target_role = EXCLUDED.target_role, summary = EXCLUDED.summary, education = EXCLUDED.education, internship = EXCLUDED.internship, projects = EXCLUDED.projects, skills = EXCLUDED.skills, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
